description: This Java class 'StringFormatter' provides static utility methods for string formatting, including indentation, log message formatting, and byte array hex dump formatting, used within the mockserver project.

classes.name: StringFormatter
classes.description: Utility class for string formatting, indentation, and byte array hex dump formatting.

methods.name: indentAndToString
methods.description: Indents objects and converts them to StringBuilder array with specified indentation.

methods.name: formatLogMessage
methods.description: Formats log messages with indentation and argument substitution.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Converts byte array to a formatted hex dump string.
